# important
- when drawing graph, make it as neat as possible
- strictly, STRICTLY, avoid making too many discrete dots i have Trypophobia
- avoid strangling messy lines
- if discrete dots are to be plotted, do not plot them, and tell me in the chat box the reason why you didn't plot them, and ask me if i want to plot them or not
- after plotting graphs, save them automatically in my folder, but do not automatically display them in the notebook, or redirect me automatically to that graph
- when drawing bar charts, do not draw margins around the bars to make them neater

# important: i have Trypophobia, if something is really messy, describe it in words and ask me if this can be plotted or not, if i say yes, then plot it, if i say no, then don't plot it
